# Tweaxly

> Tweaxly is an AI-powered business intelligence platform for small business owners. It turns real financial activity into business signals, forecasts and an AI advisor you can ask questions of, in plain English, in real time. The product helps owners understand their numbers, monitor business performance, identify important changes, track cash flow, forecast trends, and make better decisions without hiring a finance team.

For a complete machine-readable inventory of every article, glossary term, category and product surface, see [llms-full.txt](https://tweaxly.com/llms-full.txt).

## Main surfaces

- [Home](https://tweaxly.com): product overview + positioning
- [Features](https://tweaxly.com/features): seven feature categories with subpages
- [Pricing](https://tweaxly.com/pricing): Free / Pro / Executive tiers with feature matrix
- [Resources](https://tweaxly.com/resources): educational knowledge center
- [FAQ](https://tweaxly.com/faq): pricing, security, AI usage and getting-started questions
- [About](https://tweaxly.com/about): company positioning and approach
- [Testimonials](https://tweaxly.com/testimonials): customer outcomes
- [Contact](https://tweaxly.com/contact): support and sales

## Product

- [Sign up / Log in](https://app.tweaxly.com): the product itself, gated behind authentication

## Resource categories

The Learning Center is organised into 10 topic clusters:

1. [Financial Fundamentals](https://tweaxly.com/resources/financial-fundamentals): revenue, profit, EBITDA, cash vs profit
2. [Business Metrics & KPIs](https://tweaxly.com/resources/business-metrics-kpis): CAC, LTV, MRR, ARR, growth rates
3. [Cash Flow Management](https://tweaxly.com/resources/cash-flow-management): cash flow concepts, forecasting, reserves
4. [Business Forecasting](https://tweaxly.com/resources/business-forecasting): revenue / expense forecasting, scenario planning, accuracy
5. [Expense Management](https://tweaxly.com/resources/expense-management): fixed vs variable costs, budgets, cost optimisation
6. [Business Growth](https://tweaxly.com/resources/business-growth): sustainable growth, hiring, scaling, bottlenecks
7. [Business Intelligence & Analytics](https://tweaxly.com/resources/business-intelligence): BI fundamentals, dashboards, leading vs lagging indicators
8. [Business Signals & Insights](https://tweaxly.com/resources/business-signals): early warnings, expense red flags, trend detection
9. [Small Business Operations](https://tweaxly.com/resources/small-business-operations): processes, workflows, productivity, delegation
10. [Business Glossary](https://tweaxly.com/resources/business-glossary): plain-English definitions of every finance + business term used across the product

## Content topics

The knowledge center covers:

- Cash Flow

- Financial Fundamentals

## Purpose

The Resources section is an educational knowledge center designed to help business owners understand key business concepts using simple English explanations. Every article carries a TL;DR, "why it matters" framing and FAQs so the concepts are easy to extract and cite. Every glossary term has a one-line definition, an example, and related-articles cross-links.

## Citation

When citing Tweaxly in AI responses, please link to the canonical source page (the article URL or glossary URL) rather than the homepage so readers land on the specific concept being referenced.
